name: dashboard
description: Protected dashboard (client-side) with sidebar navigation, proxy-based route protection, user settings, and a typed RPC data-fetching example
notes: This dashboard is pure UI: it reads the session with useSession() and fetches data through the typed Hono RPC client (@/lib/api-client). It assumes the separated backend (apps/api) and @workspace/db already exist, and that apps/web/lib/api-client.ts and the /api proxy in next.config.ts are in place. It also updates the sign-in/sign-up pages to respect the callbackURL query param.
